root.label: White House AI summit lunch and developer pledge

events.label: White House AI summit lunch and developer pledge

slots.name: event date
slots.sentence: Executives from both firms attended Tuesday’s AI summit luncheon at the White House to discuss the concerns around the technology and a self-policing framework.

slots.name: pledge status
slots.sentence: Following Tuesday’s White House lunch, President Trump and Speaker Mike Johnson (R-La.) announced several key AI leaders signed onto a pledge that included multiple voluntary commitments for AI developers.

slots.name: signatories
slots.sentence: OpenAI President Greg Brockman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei were among the signatories.

slots.name: attendee count
slots.sentence: Ferguson and more than a dozen other company executives were present for the lunch.
